files.README.md:
# invoicer

invoicer totals the lines of an invoice, with its tax.

```python
from decimal import Decimal
from invoicer import Line, total

lines = [Line("Hosting", Decimal("40.00")), Line("Support", Decimal("15.00"), 2)]
print(total(lines, Decimal("0.19")))  # 83.30
```

from decimal import Decimal

from invoicer import Line, total


def test_total_adds_the_tax():
    lines = [Line("Hosting", Decimal("40.00")), Line("Support", Decimal("15.00"), 2)]
    assert total(lines, Decimal("0.19")) == Decimal("83.30")
